description:
***Amendment 01; The purpose of this Amendment is to incorporate both the responses to vendor questions and a revised PWS.  Response Time has been extended until March 30, 2026 at 2:00PM EST.  

The U.S. Department of Labor, Employee Benefit Security Administration (EBSA), seeks information/solutions for Form 5500 Data Subscription Services in accordance with the attached Performance Work Statement (PWS). This is a Request for Information (RFI). Please submit questions using Attachment 01 - QA Log NLT March 11, 2026. Responses to the RFI are due on March 24, 2026 at 2:00PM EST.
